resolution.category: beauty and personal care (cosmetics and skincare)
resolution.one_liner: Oakland, California-based, publicly traded (NYSE: ELF) company that makes luxurious beauty accessible for all, selling affordable cosmetics and skincare through retailers such as Target, Walmart, Ulta Beauty, Sephora and Amazon, and online.

opportunities.title: Holiday spot, Target and Best Buy aisles
opportunities.what_is_happening: e.l.f.'s first holiday spot, 'Made to Stand Out', runs on digital, social and TV-section takeovers at Best Buy and Target through the holiday season.
opportunities.why_flowcode: The in-aisle spot reaches shoppers but has no scan path, so no store-level attribution or first-party capture.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand release plus wire; TV case, different category.
opportunities.size_why: National Target and Best Buy footprint plus social.
opportunities.timing_why: Runs through holiday season; screen creative still swappable.
opportunities.suggested_play: Add an end-card Flowcode to the in-aisle spot, unique per retailer, opening a holiday gift FlowHub with shop links and email sign-up. Compare scans by store and retailer.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the media lead who controls in-store screen creative at Target and Best Buy.

play.name: Scannable TV and broadcast spots
play.play: Put a Flowcode in the spot that leads to shop, content or a sweepstakes. Use analytics to see which creative and which network drove scans, then shift media spend.

products.name: Flowcodes
products.page_quote: Drive conversions in the real world with the #1 Enterprise QR code.
products.what_it_does: Dynamic, branded QR codes for physical touchpoints. The destination can be changed after printing. Every code is measured on its own and by location.
products.use_when: The brand has a physical or broadcast touchpoint (pack, shelf, display, OOH, TV spot, venue signage, merch) with no measurable digital next step.

products.name: Analytics & Integrations
products.page_quote: Real-time analytics that feed directly into your tech stack
products.what_it_does: Real-time dashboards, a Conversion Pixel for full-funnel attribution, SmartFlow (AI-driven optimization of landing experiences), and integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce, Snowflake, Adobe, Mailchimp, Zapier, Okta and Microsoft 365.
products.use_when: The brand spends heavily on offline media (TV, OOH, retail, sponsorships) and cannot measure which placements or creative drive results.

case_study.what_they_did: Flowcodes inside a TV broadcast spot sent viewers straight to the NFL Shop store to buy.
